content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a President position at the European Central Bank. Tell about your experience in strategic monetary policy guidance, financial system stability supervision, and developing the euro area economy. Describe your vision for the ECB's role in European economic integration and the introduction of the digital euro. Length about 450 words.
